preamble: Every clue, except for the simple definition at 31, contains a misprint of one letter at some point (not necessarily in the definition part). The correct letters, read in clue order, spell out a line of verse in the Oxford Dictionary of Quotations which immediately follows a line (also in the ODQ) appropriate to the theme. Competitors should submit with their entries a clue like the rest to replace the definition at 31, whose misprinted letter will complete the quotation. NB Preference will be given to clues in which both the misprinted and the correct versions make some sense.
